purpose: Document where FLOWTRUST inherits large-scale representation learning and which large public corpora may be sampled for hard negatives/domain transfer without uncontrolled web scraping.

sources.scale: 1.689B web images in the upstream DINOv3 pretraining corpus
sources.use_in_flowtrust: Start from pretrained representation; do not attempt to reproduce billion-image pretraining. Specialize with conveyor/industrial data and hard negatives.
sources.license_action: Use official DINOv3 weights only under their model license; retain license notice.

sources.use_in_flowtrust: Reuse broad acoustic representations, then adapt on SSCC conveyor audio/vibration and evaluate leave-condition-out generalization.
sources.license_action: Dasheng repository/checkpoints Apache-2.0; each downstream source keeps its original terms.

sources.scale: 9,178,275 images total; 16M boxes; 2.8M instance masks; 61.4M image-level labels
sources.use_in_flowtrust: Curate non-conveyor hard negatives and scene-diversity negatives for the vision scene gate. Never download/train blindly on the whole corpus.
selection: explicit non-conveyor classes: person, room, wall, road, animal, food, furniture, landscape, vehicle interiors, office scenes
industrial-but-non-conveyor hard negatives: machinery, tools, pipes, warehouse scenes where available
retain source image ID, landing URL, author and license metadata
sources.license_action: Annotations CC BY 4.0. Open Images lists images as CC BY 2.0 but explicitly tells users to verify each image license; FLOWTRUST manifest must reject records without verified image-level license metadata.

sources.scale: 132.96 GB; 28 faults x 6 modes x 500 stochastic repeats, plus mode transitions and setpoint changes
sources.use_in_flowtrust: Stream balanced subsets for Chronos-2 adaptation and reserve entire seeds/modes as closed tests.
sources.license_action: CC0. Keep publication/DOI provenance even though attribution is not legally required.

sources.scale: 2,097,558 rows (~1M sensor-tag records + ~1M maintenance work orders)
sources.use_in_flowtrust: Domain vocabulary, retrieval, data-quality robustness and tool-selection examples for the operator copilot. Synthetic records are never treated as authoritative plant procedures.
Additional real-world predictive-maintenance/anomaly transfer set for pressure, temperature, motor current and valve-state dynamics.

rule: Scale is inherited or sampled with provenance. FLOWTRUST does not scrape millions of arbitrary web images without labels, license metadata or split control.
